constraints.description: Every binding-singleton acceptance criterion has direct executable evidence for all six supported JavaScript bindings.

validation.validation_method: Run the isolated packed verifier and map its manifest, resolution, behavior, and negative-peer results to the phase plan.

constraints.description: Coverage evidence exists and is non-empty, machine reports parse, strict OpenSpec validation passes, and no task remains unchecked before archive.

validation.validation_method: Parse ledgers/reports, stat evidence paths, scan tasks, and run strict OpenSpec validation.

constraints.description: Archive readiness is not presented as full 3.0 release, native-platform, immutable-SHA, RC, registry, or npm latest readiness.

validation.validation_method: Require explicit downstream ownership and stable-publication denial in evidence, coverage, and release documentation.

constraints.description: Screenshots are marked non-applicable only because this change has no rendered surface; real visual evidence remains mandatory for later examples and Docusaurus work.

validation.validation_method: Review evidence medium and downstream visual-certification routing.

constraints.description: The QA report does not imply changes to normalized entities, ID-only lists, patches, or component-to-hook-to-store I/O ownership.

validation.validation_method: Review implementation and release-impact language against repository invariants.

global_rules: Use pnpm-only evidence and packed/public artifacts where package topology is claimed.
Do not authorize or perform registry publication.
Do not use screenshots as decorative proof for physical module identity.
Do not weaken or reinterpret the phase-plan acceptance criteria.
termination_conditions: The packed singleton verifier passes from the current worktree.
Strict OpenSpec validation and evidence-integrity checks pass.
No unsupported full-release or platform claim remains.
